# apple_delete_beta_tester (Action)

Deletes a beta tester, which removes their access to every app of the account, including groups other configurations manage. To remove a tester from one group, destroy their `apple_beta_group_tester`; from one app, use `apple_remove_beta_testers_from_app`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Run with: terraform apply -invoke=action.apple_delete_beta_tester.former
data "apple_beta_tester" "former" {
  email = "former@example.com"
}

action "apple_delete_beta_tester" "former" {
  config {
    beta_tester_id = data.apple_beta_tester.former.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `beta_tester_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the beta tester.
